title: Prayer of St. Francis Before the Crucifix
text:
Most high, glorious God,
enlighten the darkness of my heart
and give me true faith, certain hope, and perfect charity,
sense and knowledge, Lord,
that I may carry out your holy and true command.
Amen.

translation.latin:
Altissime gloriosissime Deus,
illumina tenebras cordis mei
et da mihi fidem rectam, spem certam et caritatem perfectam,
sensum et cognitionem, Domine,
ut faciam sanctum et verum mandatum tuum.
Amen.

attribution: St. Francis of Assisi (authentic prayer from his writings)
notes: This is an authentic prayer of St. Francis, which he prayed before the crucifix of San Damiano when he heard Christ speak to him saying 'Go, Francis, and repair my house which, as you see, is falling into ruin.' This prayer led to his conversion and calling to rebuild the Church.
